outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rate
cohort: 52 patients who presented with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and were treated at Tentishev Satkynbai Memorial Asian Medical Institute, Kyrgyzstan, between April 2021 and January 2022
finding: GDM pregnancies were associated with higher incidences of macrosomia, NICU admissions, preterm babies, LGA babies, and increased rates of hypertensive disorders compared to pregnancies without GDM.
mod_finding: The study mentions an increased rate of cesarean sections in the context of outcomes related to gestational diabetes, but it does not provide specific findings on the mode of delivery.
